summary: Completely silent week: zero messages from either side between Aug 2-8, with the client quiet since Jul 23 and the team's last touches being Stephski's Jul 15-31 invoice and Derrek's IG phone-farm update on Aug 1. The invoice's 7-day window ran out Aug 8 with no payment confirmation and no reminder sent, despite Chey needing nudges to pay both prior invoices. Derrek promised 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the IG rollout but none were posted, and core onboarding items (sales form, previous-team unlink, IG reels uploads to Drive) were never confirmed in chat.

health.rationale: No open complaints and she referred a new client (Paige), but a full week of two-way silence, an unconfirmed invoice at its due date, an undelivered update promise, and unverified onboarding steps add real friction risk.
